title: 《哈姆雷特》— 每日精读 Read 39a

questions.question: 哈姆雷特迟迟不杀克劳狄斯，文章认为最有力的解释是？
options: 他缺的是一个信得过的地面：在新教看来显形的亡魂可能是魔鬼，他被要求凭一句无法验证的话去弑君
他天生优柔寡断，思考压过行动，任何需要果断出手的事都会让他陷入犹豫
他害怕刺杀国王失败后被处死，出于自保一直在等待更安全的时机
克劳狄斯做了他潜意识里想做的事，杀叔叔就等于杀自己，所以下不了手
questions.explanation: 他在其他事上快得吓人，迟疑只针对这一刀。浪漫派的「思考压过行动」把戏读成了性格诊断，俄狄浦斯读法文章也说文本支撑薄弱。
questions.question_en: Why does Hamlet delay killing Claudius, according to what the article considers the strongest explanation?
options_en: He lacks solid ground: in Protestant eyes a returning ghost may be a devil, and he's asked to kill a king on unverifiable word
He is by nature indecisive, thought overpowering action, so anything requiring decisiveness paralyzes him
He fears execution if the assassination fails and keeps waiting for a safer moment out of self-preservation
Claudius did what Hamlet unconsciously wished to do, so killing his uncle would mean killing himself
questions.explanation_en: He is startlingly quick in everything else; the hesitation is only about this one blow. The Romantic "thought over action" reading turns the play into a character diagnosis, and the article calls the Oedipal reading thinly supported by the text.

questions.question: 「思虑使我们全成了懦夫」（conscience does make cowards of us all）一句，按文章的读法，让人成为懦夫的是什么？
options: 对肉体死亡时剧烈痛苦的恐惧，人天生想逃避疼痛
思考本身：把事情想到底，就会把行动想没了
道德良知对杀人的禁止，让人不敢违背宗教戒律
缺乏足够的勇气，这是哈姆雷特个人性格上的弱点
questions.explanation: conscience 兼有「良知」和「思虑、自我意识」两义，两义合起来才是这句的重量：使人成为懦夫的不是恐惧，是思考本身。而且独白通篇说「我们」，不是个人的性格缺陷。
questions.question_en: In the line "conscience does make cowards of us all," what, on the article's reading, makes us cowards?
options_en: Fear of the bodily pain of dying, since humans instinctively flee pain
Thinking itself: think a thing through to the end and you think the action away
Moral conscience forbidding killing, so one dares not break religious law
A lack of courage, which is Hamlet's personal character flaw
questions.explanation_en: "Conscience" carries both "moral sense" and "reflection, self-awareness," and the line's weight needs both: what makes cowards of us is not fear but thought itself. The speech also says "we," not "I," so it isn't a personal flaw.

questions.question: 第五幕哈姆雷特终于能动手，文章认为是什么变了？
options: 雷欧提斯当天就要血债血偿的冲劲让他深感羞愧，激起了他压抑已久的血气
他终于找到确凿证据验证了鬼魂的话，疑问彻底解决
他在墓地想通了复仇在道德上正当，于是下定了决心
他不再要求由自己来选定时机，从导演变成演员，「时机成熟就是一切」
questions.explanation: 他从未验证鬼魂，也从未想清楚该不该杀；他只是不再要求想通、不再自己挑时辰。这是一个反高潮的解：绕过了问题，而不是解决了它。
questions.question_en: In Act 5 Hamlet can finally act. What does the article say has changed?
options_en: Laertes' urge to take revenge that very day shames him and stirs up his own blood
He has at last found hard proof that verifies the ghost, settling his doubts completely
In the graveyard he concludes that revenge is morally justified, and so he resolves to act
He stops insisting on choosing the moment himself, shifting from director to actor: "the readiness is all"
questions.explanation_en: He never verifies the ghost or settles whether to kill; he simply stops demanding certainty and stops picking the hour. It's an anticlimactic resolution: he goes around the question rather than answering it.
